svg.title: Where the closed loop controller runs
svg.desc: A table of where the closed loop runs. TalonFX and TalonFXS run PID and profiles on the controller and LQR on the SystemCore. SPARK MAX and SPARK Flex run PID and trapezoidal profiles on the controller, and exponential profiles and LQR on the SystemCore. The Thrifty Nova runs everything on the SystemCore. Below it, three timelines over 240 milliseconds show how often each loop runs: on the controller every 1 millisecond, which is 1 kilohertz and 240 runs; on the SystemCore every 20 milliseconds by default, which is 12 runs; and on the SystemCore at 10 milliseconds, which is 24 runs. withClosedLoopControlPeriod only changes the SystemCore loop. The period of the loop on the controller cannot be changed.
svg.text: Where the closed loop controller runs
It depends on the vendor and on what you asked for.

How often each loop runs. Every line is one run, over 240 ms:
240 runs on the controller for every 12 on the SystemCore at its default period
withClosedLoopControlPeriod only changes the SystemCore loop. The period of the loop on the controller cannot be changed.
A YAMS alert tells you when the loop is on the SystemCore.
